description: POP N' SEB - Phases Of the Moon, Never Separated Beneath
summary:
CrewSignal is a local health observation log for Windows, Android phones and Android tablets. It works offline, compares entries with your personal references and helps you prepare reports you choose to share.

Built by POP N' SEB for the 2026 NASA International Space Apps Challenge in Manila, Philippines.
